meanings.page_fit_reason: Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. A one-node wingless worker-ant dorsal example retains a continuous head/neck/mesosoma/stalk/petiole/stalk/gaster contour, two eyes, two elbowed antennae, paired anterior mandibles and six jointed legs attached to the mesosoma. This is one chosen worker form, not a universal ant species or node count; mesosoma includes thorax and propodeum.
